newsitem.title: USA: Topps closes factory, sees Q3, FY97 loss. [CORRECTED 23:59 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Topps closes factory, sees Q3, FY97 loss. [CORRECTED 23:59 GMT]

text.p: Topps Co Inc said Thursday it will close its 577-employee factory in Duryea, Pennsylvania.
Additionally, the company said it plans to outsource its Bazooka bubble gum and trading card products after a labor agreement expires in December.

Both moves should reduce manufacturing costs by at least $9 million a year, the company said. However, the company said it will take a $20 million charge to write off fixed assets and an additional amount to cover other closure costs.
(Corrects to show other closure costs are in addition to the $20 million charge.)
The company said it expects to report a net loss for the third quarter and the fiscal year ending March 1, 1997 because of the write-offs.
It said severance provisions for the employees at the Duryea factory will be negotiated further.
